For me, it's mostly great. Every country has their own problems. And everyone has different things that they care about.

I always hated the shitty internet we've had. Most people have a 2 or 4 M/bit line for the longest time. But this year there has been a massive fibre rollout across the whole country, and speeds and prices or more on par with the rest of the world which is nice. The stability of our electrical grid could be better, but it's not as bad as it was in 2007. The general infrastructure of our country is pretty good. The roads are a bit shit though.

As for safety, it really depends who you are and where you live. If you live in rural areas, then you are pretty much as safe as can be. As a middle class white person, the worst I've experienced was a few occurrences of break ins where some stuff was stolen from our house. And one time I was visiting friends in a poorer area (Krugersdorp) at about 22:00 5 armed men entered the property and held us all up at gunpoint, and cleared literally everything out of the house. There were little children in the house, but they left them alone. They just wanted stuff to sell. It wasn't scary. I was just really angry that they took my guitar which I had brought along.

Some friends have been involved in smash-and-grab situations, while waiting at traffic lights. I've had 2 guys try to pick pocket me before, but I stopped them. A friend of a friend was killed in a car theft incident, but he apparently tried to stop the thieves.

Almost everyone I know has had their house broken into or car stolen at least once in their lifetime. But most people are not harmed. Most of these crime incidents are just because of poor people trying to make a living.

It probably sounds hectic, but those are the worst situations I that I personally know about. And that's throughout an entire lifetime. 95% of the time there is nothing to worry about. And if you know what to look out for, and which areas to avoid, you will almost certainly never experience any of this.

Our biggest problem IMO is the ANC, Once they are out of the picture, and some other party that's much less shitty takes the lead, and helps grow the middle class, this country will be pretty much equivalent to living somewhere in Europe.
